GPU result, ablation_dev, base Qwen, prompt change only, no training: kill@8 0.5959 -> 0.6458 (+4.98pts). Paired McNemar on the same 542 targets: 75 gained / 48 lost, exact two-sided p=0.0187. mbpp +4.66, humaneval +6.25. Reference validity FELL 0.5826 -> 0.5381. MECHANISM CHECK CONTRADICTS THE INTENTION: relational assertions rose 0.28%->4.38% of candidates, but only 13 of the 75 newly-killed targets (17.3%) were killed by a relation; 57 were killed by a literal oracle, the form the prompt told the model to avoid. bounded collapsed 29.7%->9.7% while literal_oracle rose 67.6%->83.6% - the model became MORE committal, not less.

LOCKED PANEL VERDICT: metamorphic prompt gives +0.0159 (0.6209 -> 0.6367), paired McNemar 80 gained / 68 lost, p=0.366 - NOT significant. humaneval delta exactly 0.0000. Reference validity fell 0.4536 -> 0.4123. ablation_dev overstated this by 3.1x and turned p=0.366 into p=0.0187. Decision: do NOT adopt, do NOT train on it. The value-free direction is recorded as measured-and-rejected rather than untried.

steps.summary: DECISION: reject the value-free/metamorphic direction for adoption. The ceiling is real (+6.85 broad / +2.71 strict on locked val) but a model given the option produces only +1.59, p=0.366, while losing 4 points of reference validity - and 83% of what it did gain came from literal oracles, not relations. Recorded as measured-and-rejected rather than untried. Also rejects publishing the ablation_dev figure: it overstated by 3.1x.
